query:
UPDATE asset_inventory_items
        SET
            serial_number = $2,
            batch_number = $3,
            quantity_on_hand = $4::double precision::numeric,
            quantity_allocated = $5::double precision::numeric,
            location_id = $6,
            status = $7,
            public_notes = $8,
            internal_notes = $9,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE inventory_item_id = $1
